Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In Step 11, the Planner incorrectly analyzes the WebSurfer's data from the Caligula Wikipedia page. The Planner states, "The WebSurfer data so far indicates... Caligula is described as the son of Germanicus and Agrippina the Younger." This is a hallucination; the text provided in the WebSurfer's previous turn (Step 10) explicitly states Caligula was the son of "Germanicus and Agrippina the Elder." The Planner falsely claims the text says "Agrippina the Younger," leading to the contradictory conclusion that the mother-in-law is Agrippina the Younger instead of Agrippina the Elder.
